faqs.q: How do I get my pattern after I buy it?
faqs.a: Bought on this website? Your download button appears right after payment and stays under My purchases in your sewing room. Bought on Etsy? Etsy shows a download button on the order page, and you can find it any time under You, then Purchases and reviews.

faqs.q: Do you post a paper pattern?
faqs.a: No. Every pattern is a digital PDF, so nothing is shipped. That also means there are no postage costs or customs waits, wherever you live.

faqs.q: Can I buy from outside the US?
faqs.a: Yes. Prices are in US dollars. On this website you pay with PayPal or a card through PayPal, and on Etsy you can pay in your own currency. The download works the same everywhere.

faqs.q: What do I need to print it?
faqs.a: A home printer with A4 or US Letter paper. Print at 100 percent or actual size, never fit to page. You can also take the A0 file to a copy shop and get the whole pattern on a few large sheets.

faqs.q: How do I pick my size?
faqs.a: Measure your bust, waist and hips with a soft tape and compare them with the size chart in the pattern. If you sit between two sizes, trace the larger one and take it in at the side seams.
Digital files download instantly, so they can't be returned. If a file won't open or something looks wrong, message us and we'll help you sort it out.
